decision: The exact product metadata supports a separately gated, local header and pixel QA attempt for M1-SRC-002. It does not establish actual raster types, projected grid, AOI coverage, valid mask distribution, registration, before/after map readiness, scientific baseline admission, change, or attribution. Keep the DEM raster outside display/export unless its separate rights are resolved; retain the exact product credits for any conditional local map. Do not request M1-SRC-005 until this source's individual QA gates pass.
